groups.headline: 01 · Headline figures
groups.technical: Kept mono · Technical & named brand exception

pages.title: Today · Eaten / Goal
pages.note: Eaten changes; the existing serif denominator stays serif. Lower specimens test width, not additional Today metrics.

pages.title: History · Summary
pages.note: Only type changes. Values are fixed fictional specimens; no live account or write path.

pages.title: Today · Food rows
pages.note: Approved Variant A art: unchanged 56 px slot, 18 px/500 name, portion, right-aligned energy and macro line. No photos in rows.

pages.title: Today’s log
pages.note: SectionHeading detail and both time branches are included; reused food rows are also visible.

pages.title: Macro wash columns
pages.note: Shared V1MacroStrip valueText: Today and historical drill-down. The 108 px trailing column stays fixed; wash is illustrative.

pages.title: History · Ledger
pages.note: Compact date labels, numeric ledger columns and list comparison/delta. No historical-target policy change is implied.

pages.title: 12 September
pages.note: Over, on-target and zero specimens. This reproduces source wording; it is not a correction to comparison logic.

pages.title: Journal · Gutter date
pages.note: The date keeps 0.5 px tracking and its rotated gutter position. Header dates already in other faces are not changed.

pages.title: Auth & setup labels
pages.note: These inherited mono labels are not technical strings: the candidate moves them to diary serif. “morsel” wordmarks are retained separately, per the explicit issue inventory.

pages.title: Weight trend
pages.note: Chart text only: 9/10/12 px. Weight trace, missing-data symbols and axis positions are illustrative browser reconstructions; not Swift Charts proof.

pages.title: 16 September
pages.note: All six receipt value rows; fixed fictional historical records. Confirmed addition is a specimen, never a suggestion.

pages.title: Unavailable records
pages.note: Nil branches retain honest text. No missing value is shown as zero; no Health interpretation.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.note: Month-grid digits and first-log range. Only typography changes; calendar selection/flip behaviour is not implemented or proposed here.

pages.title: What are we aiming for?
pages.note: Current Goals uses 22 px calories and 17 px macro fields. The 30 px Goals gauge named in the issue is absent at this pinned base; no fake gauge has been minted.

pages.title: One more pass…
pages.note: Validation strings share morselData; candidate is serif prose at the same 11 px. Blank input stays blank; source errors are shown without inventing a saved value.

pages.title: Ruled field states
pages.note: Shared field typography only. “Optional” is a placeholder specimen, not zero. Only Goals supplies inline field errors at this base. Keyboard, focus and native Dynamic Type remain unverified.

pages.title: Existing training receipt
pages.note: Baseline-only type comparison of the current receipt. Half (a) removes this from Today; this gallery does not reintroduce it or decide the half-(a) layout.

pages.title: Existing amount field
pages.note: Half-(a) overlap accounted for. The current 11 px medium font is compared without proposing its old layout for implementation. No numeric default.

pages.title: Add a meal
pages.note: Quantity is prominent 22 px; optional nutrition is 17 px. Values are fixed input specimens, not food estimates or saved records.

pages.title: Edit food
pages.note: Same fixed data before and after; no save, mutation, photo access or database connection.

pages.title: Food · Provenance
pages.note: Confidence lives in the detail sheet, never the row. The confidence formatter outputs whole percentages; both warning strings are verbatim from the pinned source.

pages.title: Your menus
pages.note: Both menu.summaryLine consumers, including counts and total energy. Names and values are fictional.

pages.title: Edit menu
pages.note: Menu quantity is 17 px, not the prominent 22 px capture/edit quantity. Unit and food name stay in their existing serif voice.

pages.title: Add meal · Photo
pages.note: Photo bytes are not accessed. File-size specimen and nontechnical status/control copy change; photo contents are not invented.

pages.title: Edit · Photo & illustration
pages.note: The food illustration remains unchanged. Detail-only photo/picker/permission states are not re-minted; text states are source-derived specimens.

pages.title: MCP endpoint
pages.note: Unchanged mono: endpoint and its technical configuration status. URL is a display-only specimen; no link or request is made.

pages.title: Claude · Setup prompt
pages.note: Exact retained prompt text with the display endpoint substituted. Technical setup strings remain mono, including numbered steps. No commands execute.

pages.title: ChatGPT / Others · Setup prompt
pages.note: Exact retained prompt text with the display endpoint substituted. Technical setup strings remain mono, including numbered steps. No commands execute.

pages.title: Copy & brand exceptions
pages.note: Copy pills and the explicitly retained wordmark remain mono. Brand is the issue’s named exception, not falsely classified as numeric or technical prose.

pages.title: History · Day macros
pages.note: The same three MacroWashStrip fields inside DayDrillDown. Six total static macro call sites across Today and expanded History are enumerated in COVERAGE.md.

pages.title: Food · Missing values
pages.note: Missing calories remain an em dash; absent macros retain the source string “No macro data”. No invented zero or nutrient estimate.

pages.title: Weight · Caption states
pages.note: Current MorselFormat.number uses whole-number precision. The decimal example in the old WeightTrendView comment is stale; no formatter change is proposed.

pages.title: Receipt · Unconfirmed
pages.note: Shared receipt branches appear in both current Today and the current editor sheet. Half (a) supersedes their placement; this is typography-only baseline evidence.

pages.title: Illustration · Provenance
pages.note: All nonempty illustrationCopy families. The .none branch emits no text; it is not fabricated as a fourth visible value.

pages.title: New menu
pages.note: New-menu host of the same MenuEditorSheet numeric fields. Optional calories are shown as placeholder text, not a zero default.

pages.title: Shared date furniture
pages.note: All eight page-furniture hosts, enumerated explicitly. Dates are unrotated here for comparing the small type; journal-folios shows the gutter orientation. No navigation is changed.
